name: police_shootings_summary
description: Aggregate counts of U.S. fatal police shootings since 2015, from The Washington Post Fatal Force database. Group by state, year, race, armed_with, threat_type, gender, mental_illness, or body_camera; optionally scope to one state and/or one year first. Returns only counts — never names (use police_shootings for individual incidents). CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, attributed to The Washington Post.

group_by.description: How to bucket the counts. Default "year".

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code to scope to (e.g. "CA"). Optional.

year.description: Calendar year to scope to (2015-present). Optional.

name: police_shootings
description: Individual fatal police shooting incidents (including the name of the person killed), from The Washington Post Fatal Force database. Filter by state, city, year, armed_with, and/or race. Small by default (limit, default 25, max 200) — a truncated response carries truncated:true, total_matching, and a narrowing hint. For counts/breakdowns only, use police_shootings_summary instead. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, attributed to The Washington Post.

city.description: City name, exact match case-insensitive. Optional.

armed_with.description: What the person was reported armed with, e.g. "gun", "knife", "unarmed", "vehicle", "unknown". Optional.

race.description: Race code as the Post records it: W (white), B (black), H (hispanic), A (asian), N (native american), O (other). Optional.

name: agency_shootings
description: One law-enforcement agency's fatal-shooting count and breakdown (by year, race, armed_with), from The Washington Post Fatal Force database agency roster. Matches on a name fragment (e.g. "Sacramento Police"); pass state to disambiguate if more than one agency matches. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, attributed to The Washington Post.

agency.description: Agency name or a fragment of it, e.g. "Sacramento Police Department" or "Sacramento".

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code to disambiguate multiple matches. Optional.
